devdoc.details: Utilizes Ethereum's CREATE2 opcode for deploying contracts with predictable addresses.

params.implementation: The address of the router implementation used by the proxy.
params.owner: The address which will be the admin and owner of the newly deployed proxy.

computeProxyAddress(address,address).details: The computed address is determined by the owner's address and the factory's address

params.owner: The prospective admin and owner of the new proxy contract.
params.routerImplementation: router contract which implements routing functions

returns._0: The address where the proxy will be deployed.

deployProxy(address,address).details: Emits a ProxyDeployed event upon successful deployment.      Note that the deployment can be initiated by any caller, on behalf of `owner`.

params.owner: The address to be set as initial admin and immutable owner of the proxy.
params.routerImplementation: router contract which implements routing functions

returns.proxy: The address of the newly deployed RouterProxy.

instantiate(address,address).details: If the proxy already exists at the computed address, the function will not redeploy it.      The `created` return value indicates whether the proxy was created as a result of this call.

params.owner: The address to be set as initial admin and immutable owner of the proxy.
params.routerImplementation: router contract which implements routing functions

returns.created: A boolean indicating if the proxy was created during this call.

devdoc.title: Mangrove Router Proxy Factory

ProxyDeployed(address,address,address).notice: Emitted when a new proxy is deployed through this factory.

computeProxyAddress(address,address).notice: Computes the deterministic address of a proxy deployed for a specific owner using CREATE2.

deployProxy(address,address).notice: Deploys a new RouterProxy for a given owner.

instantiate(address,address).notice: Deploys a RouterProxy for a given owner if one has not already been deployed.

userdoc.notice: Factory contract for the deployment of RouterProxy instances using CREATE2 for deterministic addresses.
